build.board: ClockworkPi PicoCalc + Raspberry Pi Pico H

completed_software_items: Unified .mks/.sheet, WBMP and FMK opening through browser, terminal and M61; common extension dispatch.
Shared autoexec selection on entering a directory: autoexec.m61 first, then autoexec.tbi.
Shared graphical Markdown layout with styles, lists, headings, quotes/code, inline WBMP, paging, selected links and return history.
External /Fonts FMK2 UI catalog, atomic CRC-checked PFK2 preparation, stable saved keys and idle clock shared by LCD and USB Screen.
ARMv6-M HardFault handler with independent emergency stack, retained CRC record, automatic microSD reports, actual watchdog telemetry and timer profiling.
Native ABI resource operation 6 content stamps and checked reserved=2 reads, stable across unrelated file changes and invalidated across USB ownership.
CI installs pinned Rust and both targets, executes packed/relocated ARM APPs, packages clean output and builds production STM32 resident/System targets.

cases: native ARMv6-M resource stamps, stale reads, UI font catalog/glyphs, prepared-font CRC and restoration
idle clock HH:MM: exact calculator and USB Screen raster; RTC restored to current local time
graphical Markdown styles, inline WBMP pixel oracle, paging, links and back history
WBMP direct file opening uses the image viewer
Explorer entering directories executes autoexec.m61 and autoexec.tbi
real timer profiles, saved profile and watchdog telemetry
external UI font selection and settings survive a real warm reset
intentional ARM HardFault capture, emergency stack, RAM retention, automatic SD report and watchdog hang recovery
program memory, five stack values, registers and terminal directory restored
